description: crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs defines BackendChangesError<E> with a From<BackendChangesError<E>> for JmapError impl. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/backend.rs and crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs define BackendSetError<E> but there is no From<E> for BackendSetError<E> impl, only From<SetError>. This forces callers to write .map_err(BackendSetError::Other) at every backend call site instead of using ?. BackendChangesError correctly has impl<E> From<E> for BackendChangesError<E> enabling ?. BackendSetError should have the same impl for consistency and to eliminate repetitive .map_err(BackendSetError::Other) call sites.
title: BackendChangesError and BackendSetError have no From<BackendSetError<E>> for BackendSetError<F>
